title: Expand claude-code-cli supplement: hook event catalog + MCP + sub-agents + OTel signal catalog + FinOps queries
description:
Goal: 

Acceptance criteria:
- 

For the revised AIE domain (crosslink #2) to actually answer substrate questions concretely, claude-code-cli supplement needs new sections: (1) Hook event catalog — SessionStart / PreToolUse / PostToolUse / UserPromptSubmit / Stop / SubagentStop / Notification — each with doc URL, firing-conditions, cost-impact, problem-to-hook mapping; (2) MCP server pattern — registration, tool surface; (3) Sub-agent via Task tool — when to use, prompt structure, cost; (4) Statusline + CLAUDE.md + slash commands + background tasks; (5) OTel signal catalog — metrics, log events, traces, FinOps queries, hook-attribute-injection bridge for per-skill/per-domain/per-phase attribution. Substantial but tractable.
